# SPRINGS OF CALIFORNIA.

# ST. HELENA WHITE SULPHUR SPRINGS (NAPA 10).

St. Helena White Sulphur Springs are situated in the canyon of Sulphur Creek, 2 miles southwest of the town of St. Helena. They form the nucleus of an old and formerly a well-known resort, but about 1904 the hotel was destroyed by fire, and in 1909 the improve- ments had not been extensively rebuilt. There were, however, cottages and an open screened dining room, furnishing accommoda- tions for about 25 people, and a small bathhouse near one of the springs.

Analyses of water from St. Helena White Sulphur Springs, Napa County, Cal.

[Constituents are in parts per million.]
